summary: The new mathematics (parameter-level associativity, ideal-free closure) is not duplicated in Mathlib or TauCeti, but the PR leaves two hand-rolled copies of the very lemma it just made public, and its `hstep` is a fourth in-file copy of an evaluation-transport that three existing proofs already open-code.
